rawEvidenceNotes.zeroFieldsAreAnyRowZero: zeroFields flags a key if any sampled row is 0, not if the field is always zero. plusone_poss_pct is 0.022 for SGA isolation and 0 for Achiuwa. charges_drawn is 0 for Durant only.

rawEvidenceNotes.naiveClassCCaveat: Script class C used string matching against Advanced Stats V2 names. general/advanced usg_pct, efg_pct, ts_pct, off_rating, def_rating, poss are Class B (season rollup of existing Advanced), not unique. l/w/season_id/team_name/play_type/type_grouping are metadata.

targetedArchiveEstimate.pagesIfUnfilteredPlayer: unknown; do not run unfiltered. Sample of 5 players = 1 page. League-wide player lists would be multiple pages at per_page=100.
targetedArchiveEstimate.safeBatchPlan: Reuse known BDL player IDs from logs in batches of <=100 player_ids[]. ~5 batches × 11 player types × 3 seasons = 165 player requests + 8 team types × 3 seasons = 24 team requests ≈ 189 HTTP.
targetedArchiveEstimate.estimatedS3Mb: ~12 MB (characterization ~670–800 bytes/player/category; 500 players × 11 types × 3 seasons ≈ 11 MB plus team objects)
targetedArchiveEstimate.note: Do not archive without player_ids[]/team_ids[] filters. Unfiltered player endpoints can paginate into a crawl. This estimate is not executed.
